sites.name: Citadel of the Ho Dynasty (Tay Do Citadel)
sites.event: A UNESCO World Cultural Heritage site, the capital of Dai Ngu under the Ho Dynasty, and one of the most unique and solid stone architectural works in Southeast Asia.

place.commune: Vinh Long Commune, Vinh Tien Commune

sites.name: Lam Kinh Historical Relic Area
sites.event: The base of the Lam Son Uprising and the resting and worship place of the kings and queen mothers of the Later Le Dynasty; home to the Vinh Lang Stele composed by Nguyen Trai.

sites.name: Sam Son Beach
sites.event: A famous beach resort developed by the French since 1906, associated with the legend of Hon Trong Mai and Doc Cuoc Temple.

place.commune: Wards: Bac Son, Trung Son, Truong Son, Quang Cu...

sites.name: Cam Luong Sacred Fish Stream
sites.event: A mysterious stream with thousands of large and small 'gioc' fish crowding together that locals never eat, associated with the legend of the Snake God.

sites.name: Ham Rong Bridge
sites.event: Known as the 'sacred Ham Rong', a symbol of resilient will during the anti-American resistance war (a fiery coordinate protecting the vital route).

sites.name: Pu Luong Nature Reserve
sites.event: Famous for its beautiful terraced rice fields, limestone karst ecosystem, and the indigenous culture of the Thai and Muong ethnic groups.

place.commune: Thanh Lam Commune, Co Lung Commune (and neighboring communes)
place.district: Ba Thuoc District (and Quan Hoa District)

sites.name: Ba Trieu Temple
sites.event: The place of worship for the national heroine Trieu Thi Trinh (Lady Trieu), who rode an elephant to drive away the Eastern Wu invaders (in 248).

sites.name: Ben En National Park
sites.event: Likened to the 'Ha Long Bay on land' of the Thanh region with the vast Song Muc Lake and rich flora and fauna.

place.commune: Hai Van Commune, Xuan Thai Commune, Binh Luong Commune...
place.district: Nhu Thanh District, Nhu Xuan District

sites.name: Le Hoan Temple
sites.event: A special national relic site, the place of worship for King Le Dai Hanh, outstanding for its unique 'Cong' character-shaped architecture and exquisite wood carving art.

sites.name: Hai Tien Beach
sites.event: An emerging beach with pristine beauty, a long sandy shore, and lush green casuarina groves.

place.commune: Hoang Tien Commune, Hoang Hai Commune, Hoang Thanh Commune...

sites.name: Voi Waterfall
sites.event: A beautiful, pristine waterfall, legend has it that King Quang Trung's war elephants stopped here to drink water on their way north (for the Ngoc Hoi - Dong Da battle).

sites.name: Hon Trong Mai
sites.event: A scenic spot located on Truong Le Mountain, consisting of three stacked boulders resembling a pair of male and female birds, symbolizing faithful love.
